rules.requirement: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.

assertingTests.name: Ravenkeeper wakes after a night death and learns a character (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01, SYS-NIGHT-02)
the Ravenkeeper step is appended when the Ravenkeeper dies at night (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01, SYS-NIGHT-02)
the Ravenkeeper step before a player is chosen is a character question and cannot be completed (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01)
the Ravenkeeper step keeps the chosen player's character as its record and writes one step line (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01)
the Ravenkeeper may choose any player, the Demon and its own seat included (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01)
a healthy Ravenkeeper step stores what the host sends and journals it as a registration choice (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01)
a Recluse may be shown to the Ravenkeeper as a Minion or the Demon, alive or dead (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01, TB-RECLUSE-01)
a Spy may be shown to the Ravenkeeper as a Townsfolk or an Outsider (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01, TB-SPY-01)
the Ravenkeeper step previews, applies and replays with the command clock and ids (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01)
the Ravenkeeper module declares one player and the character shape and keeps its wake (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01)
the Ravenkeeper learns the chosen player's character (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01)
the Ravenkeeper names every character the chosen player may register as (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01)
the Ravenkeeper has no answer before a player is chosen (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01)
